messages.subject: Does strategy='gaussian' influence posterior.sample?
parts: Does setting `control.inla=list(strategy='gaussian', int.strategy='eb')` have an effect on the behavior of posterior.sample? Or does changing strategy only influence the approximated marginal posteriors?
